field.label: Code Length
field.comment: Number of digits in the OTP. Lower this only together with Max Verify Attempts — a short code with a generous attempt cap is brute-forceable.

field.label: Code Lifetime (seconds)
field.comment: How long an issued code stays valid. Default 300 (5 minutes).

field.label: Max Verify Attempts Per Code
field.comment: After this many wrong entries the code is revoked and the shopper must request a new one.

field.label: Resend Cooldown (seconds)
field.comment: Minimum gap between two sends to the same number. Also drives the countdown on the Resend button.

field.label: Max Sends Per Phone Per Window
Max Sends Per IP Per Window
field.comment: Guards against one host farming SMS sends across many numbers. Keep this well above the per-phone limit — Egyptian mobile carriers put many genuine shoppers behind a single shared address.

field.label: Rate Limit Window (seconds)
field.comment: The rolling window both limits above are counted over. Default 3600 (1 hour).

field.label: Verification Proof Lifetime (seconds)
field.comment: How long after a successful OTP the shopper has to finish registration or set a new password. Default 900 (15 minutes).

field.label: Purge OTP Records After (days)
field.comment: A daily cron deletes spent OTP rows older than this. Every row holds a phone number, so a short ledger is a data-retention requirement, not housekeeping.

field.label: Gateway
field.comment: Log (no delivery) writes the code to var/log/spartrak_otp.log and sends nothing — correct for staging, never for production. Add a provider by implementing Spartrak\CustomerAuth\Api\SmsGatewayInterface and registering it in the gateways argument of Spartrak\CustomerAuth\Model\Sms\GatewayResolver in di.xml.

field.label: Sender ID
field.comment: The alphanumeric sender the SMS appears to come from. Egyptian carriers require this to be pre-registered with the provider before it will deliver.

field.label: Default Country Calling Code
field.comment: Applied when a shopper types a local number with no country code. 20 = Egypt.

field.label: Placeholder Email Domain
field.comment: Used to synthesize the email address Magento requires when a shopper registers with a phone number only. Must be an undeliverable domain — keep it under .invalid (RFC 2606) so it can never belong to a real recipient.
